models.name: economy_politics_board_users
models.description:
Registered users with email/password credentials and authentication status.

Represents the primary identity record for standard community members. This table contains core user authentication data including email and password hash. Each user has a unique email address for login purposes.

Key relationships:
- Linked to user_sessions (many-to-one)
- Linked to user_password_resets (many-to-one)
- Linked to user_email_verifications (many-to-one)

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for user authentication. Must follow valid email format standard.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last account modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Account deletion timestamp (for soft delete).

models.name: economy_politics_board_user_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access/refresh support and expiration handling for regular user accounts. Tracks login sessions with security metadata including IP, user agent, and session duration for security auditing and session management.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User account's {@link economy_politics_board_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from where session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of request that initiated the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referer URL of request that initiated the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Exact moment session was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for security purposes.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When session automatically expires (24 hours from creation).

models.name: economy_politics_board_user_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for user authentication management with expiration and usage tracking.

This table stores tokens for password reset requests with expiration dates and usage status. Tokens are unique per user session and automatically expire to ensure security. Managed strictly through user-related operations within the authentication workflow.

foreignFields.name: economy_politics_board_users_id
foreignFields.description: User's {@link economy_politics_board_users.id} that requested the password reset.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token for authentication and verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset token expires (must be a future timestamp).

plainFields.name: is_used
plainFields.description: Whether the password reset token has already been used for a password change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp when the record changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When record was soft-deleted (for audit trail).

models.name: economy_politics_board_user_email_verifications
models.description: Tracks email verification tokens for users, including status and expiration. Associated with a user record through the users_id foreign key. Ensures verification process integrity with timestamp tracking of each token's lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: users_id
foreignFields.description: The associated user's identifier. {@link economy_politics_board_users.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Email verification token string.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used for verification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the verification: pending, verified, or expired.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the verification record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was marked as deleted (soft delete), or null if not deleted.

models.name: economy_politics_board_admins
models.description:
Administrators with email/password credentials and elevated permissions.

This table stores administrator identities that require authentication and have elevated permissions beyond regular users.

- **Email** is used for credential matching
- **Password hash** stores securely hashed credentials
- **Temporal fields** support auditing and soft deletion
- **Unique email constraint** ensures valid sign-in identifiers

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for admin account (must match standard email format).

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash stored securely (using bcrypt algorithm).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was soft-deleted (null if not deleted).

models.name: economy_politics_board_admin_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrators with enhanced security. Tracks active sessions for administrators with enhanced security requirements, including IP, headers, and referrer information for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: economy_politics_board_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator who owns this session. {@link economy_politics_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current URL or request URI for the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: URL that referred the user to this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires (must be NOT NULL for security).

models.name: economy_politics_board_admin_password_resets

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description:
Admin user account this reset token belongs to. {
@\link economy_politics_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique one-time token for password reset process

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for token validity (max 1 hour)

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was successfully used for reset

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail

models.name: economy_politics_board_admin_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for administrator accounts, enabling secure email address validation during registration or update processes. Each token is time-bound, single-use, and linked to the administrator's account for verification context.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to associated administrator account. {@link economy_politics_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to administrator's email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when verification token expires (24 hours after creation).

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email address was successfully verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token record was soft-deleted.

models.name: economy_politics_board_super_admins
models.description: Super administrators with email/password credentials and all permissions. Represents the highest authority level with full platform access and management capabilities, distinct from standard administrators. This table stores core identity and authentication details for super administrators, while their sessions are handled separately through dedicated session tables to maintain proper relational structure and security practices.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's primary contact email address for authentication and notifications. Must be unique across all actor types and pass valid email format validation.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password used for authentication. Stored using industry-standard hashing algorithms with salting for security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the super administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the super administrator account details were last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the super administrator account was marked for deletion (soft delete). Null indicates active account.

models.name: economy_politics_board_super_admin_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for super administrators with maximum security, including connection metadata and expiration tracking. All session data is append-only for security auditing.

foreignFields.name: economy_politics_board_super_admins_id
foreignFields.description: Super administrator's {@link economy_politics_board_super_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: User's IP address during login.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Origin URL from where request was made.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session expires, calculated based on security policies.

models.name: economy_politics_board_super_admin_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for super administrator accounts, storing token values, expiration, and associated admin references. Each token is uniquely associated with a super administrator account and expires after a set period.

Key relationship: Belongs to super_admins actor table (one-to-many relationship: one super admin can have multiple password reset tokens).

foreignFields.name: super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the super administrator's account. {@link economy_politics_board_super_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token used for password reset verification. Must be generated as a secure random string.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp of the password reset token. Must be in UTC format.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the token record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was invalidated (soft delete). Null indicates active token.

models.name: economy_politics_board_super_admin_email_verifications
models.description:
Tracks email verification tokens for super administrators. Each token is generated for a super administrator's email address during the registration process, allowing them to verify ownership before account activation.

The email verification lifecycle:
1. Token generated with expiration (default 24 hours)
2. User receives verification email
3. Token validated to activate account
4. Verification token marked as verified

All verification tokens are automatically expired after 24 hours to maintain security.

foreignFields.name: super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: References the super_admin whose email is being verified. {@link economy_politics_board_super_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure random token used to verify the email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token expires (24 hours after creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token status was last updated.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email address was successfully verified. NULL if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was soft-deleted.

models.name: economy_politics_board_system_error_handling_rules
models.description:
Stores system error codes, handling strategies, and message templates for error handling scenarios including system-wide error configuration.

This table is used to define how different error types should be handled across the platform, with configurable message templates that support dynamic replacement of variables.

Critical for consistent error communication and user experience during error states.

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Unique error identifier that corresponds to specific error conditions.

plainFields.name: handling_strategy
plainFields.description: Strategy for handling this error type (e.g., 'retry', 'log', 'notify')

plainFields.name: message_template
plainFields.description: Template string for error messages that will be dynamically rendered with context variables.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the error configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the error configuration was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the error configuration was marked as deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economy_politics_board_system_performance_thresholds
models.description: Defines measurable performance thresholds for critical system operations and user experience metrics. Includes response time requirements for search, content handling, and concurrent requests, with criticality levels indicating severity. All thresholds are system-defined and managed via configuration.

plainFields.name: performance_metric
plainFields.description: Name of the performance metric (e.g., 'search_response_time', 'request_throughput'). This is the identifier for the threshold category.

plainFields.name: threshold_value
plainFields.description: The threshold value against which performance is measured. For example, a response time threshold of 200ms is represented as 200.0.

plainFields.name: unit
plainFields.description: Measurement unit for the threshold value (e.g., 'ms', 'sec', 'requests_per_second'). Must be a valid metric unit.

plainFields.name: criticality
plainFields.description: Criticality level of the threshold (high, medium, low). Indicates the severity of the threshold breach.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Additional details and context about this threshold, including use cases and business implications.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the threshold was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the threshold.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the threshold was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: economy_politics_board_sections
models.description: Stores section definitions including unique name, descriptive content, and creation metadata for article categorization. Sections are required to have unique names and descriptive content (minimum 20 characters).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique section identifier displayed to users.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the section's purpose and topic focus (minimum 20 characters).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was soft-deleted (nullable for soft delete implementation).

models.name: economy_politics_board_articles
models.description: Main article content including title, content, section reference, and author with creation timestamp. Articles are created by users, organized within sections, and support text content with minimum 50 character requirement. This table connects articles to their section and author through foreign keys. Note: article attachments are stored separately in economy_politics_board_article_attachments and tags in economy_politics_board_article_tags tables.

foreignFields.name: section_id
foreignFields.description: Section this article belongs to. {@link economy_politics_board_sections.id}

foreignFields.name: author_id
foreignFields.description: Author of this article (user identity). {@link economy_politics_board_users.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title (minimum 5 characters).

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Article content (minimum 50 characters).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Article creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Article last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Article deletion timestamp (for soft delete).

models.name: economy_politics_board_article_attachments
models.description:
File attachments associated with articles, including file type, size, and download URL. Each attachment is linked to a single article and managed as part of article content.

Attachments are stored as separate records to maintain article content integrity and support 1:N relationship between articles and their attachments.

foreignFields.name: economy_politics_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article's {@link economy_politics_board_articles.id}.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the file attachment.

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: Size of the file in bytes.

plainFields.name: download_url
plainFields.description: Permanent URL for file download.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (null when not deleted).

models.name: economy_politics_board_article_tags
models.description:
User-added tags for article categorization with maximum 5 tags per article. Tags must be free text limited to 30 characters with no duplicates allowed per article.

This table is managed exclusively through the article entity (economy_politics_board_articles) and requires no standalone API endpoints. Tags serve as secondary categorization for search and section filtering.

**Why subsidiary?**
- Tags require article context for meaningful use
- Users add/remove tags through article management flows
- No independent management capabilities exist (unlike primary entities)

foreignFields.name: economy_politics_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article this tag belongs to {@link economy_politics_board_articles.id}.

plainFields.name: tag
plainFields.description: User-provided tag text limited to 30 characters for categorization.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of tag creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last tag update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of tag deletion (soft delete).

models.name: economy_politics_board_administrator_requests
models.description: Tracks user requests to become administrators with status, reason, and timestamps. Each user can submit only one active request (pending) at a time. Requires user context and approval status tracking for administrative workflows.

foreignFields.name: users_id
foreignFields.description: User who submitted the request. {@link economy_politics_board_users.id.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the request (pending, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by the user requesting administrator privileges.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the request.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was marked as deleted.

models.name: economy_politics_board_user_bans
models.description:
Records user bans with details, reasons, duration and admin justification. Banned users cannot login to the platform. Each ban entry tracks the reason and optional expiration date.

- Ban reasons require minimum 10 characters
- Expiration dates may be indefinite (NULL)
- Linked to both user and admin tables

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User being banned's {@link economy_politics_board_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who imposed the ban's {@link economy_politics_board_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for ban (min 10 characters).

plainFields.name: start_at
plainFields.description: Start date/time of ban.

plainFields.name: expire_at
plainFields.description: Expiration date/time of ban (optional for indefinite bans).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the ban record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the ban record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the ban was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economy_politics_board_search_queries
models.description:
Stores user search terms with timestamps and request parameters. This table captures the search terms entered by users and the parameters used for each search, enabling the system to track and analyze search patterns.

Each record represents a single search term and its associated request parameters. The table is used to support the search and filtering features of the platform, particularly for tracking search history and improving search relevance.

plainFields.name: search_term
plainFields.description: The actual search term entered by the user.

plainFields.name: request_parameters
plainFields.description: Additional parameters from the search request, stored as JSON string for flexibility.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the search query was first recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the search query record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the search query was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: economy_politics_board_search_results
models.description: Caches search results for performance, linked to articles and tags. Stores optimized query results for faster search operations while maintaining reference to source articles and associated tags.

foreignFields.name: articles_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged article's {@link economy_politics_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: article_tags_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged tag's {@link economy_politics_board_article_tags.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp if deleted.

models.name: economy_politics_board_search_filters
models.description:
Persistent user filter configurations for tag-based search. Stores user-specific preferences such as tag combinations, search parameters, and filter criteria.

This table captures saved filter configurations that users can reuse across multiple searches. Each record is uniquely tied to a user's account and is intended for personalizing search results without requiring repeated configuration.

The 'config' field stores filter settings as JSON string formatted data (e.g., {"tags":["economy","politics"],"recent":true}).

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User who created this filter configuration {@link economy_politics_board_users.id}.

plainFields.name: filter_name
plainFields.description: Descriptive name of the filter configuration (e.g., 'Recent Articles', 'Economy Focus').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the filter's purpose or content.

plainFields.name: config
plainFields.description: Serialized filter configuration data in JSON format defining tag preferences and search parameters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the filter configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the filter configuration was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the filter configuration was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economy_politics_board_search_query_histories
models.description:
Tracks historical search queries performed by each user, enabling personalized search recommendations and analytics. This table captures full user search terms for historical analysis and recommendation generation while maintaining user-level ownership of search history entries.

This subsidiary table depends directly on user activity and is managed through user interaction workflows. It contains no business attributes beyond search context, with no independent CRUD operations required.

foreignFields.name: economy_politics_board_search_query_id
foreignFields.description: The search query that this history entry belongs to. {@link economy_politics_board_search_queries.id}.

plainFields.name: search_terms
plainFields.description: The search terms entered by the user, used for recommendations and search history tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the search entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the search entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the search entry was soft-deleted, if applicable.
